templates.why_chosen: Dense 15-component figure whose bottom legend spells out six path types (Tx/Rx control, Tx/Rx data, host data, auxiliary), all converging on one mandatory Attestation-kernel choke point between PCIe DMA and the RoCE protocol kernel.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw a security module as a literal inline choke point on both Tx and Rx paths, not a side box, so nothing bypasses it; this figure legends six path classes below, more than the template's usual three-class cap, so only go that far if every class needs its own arrow style.
